summary_1line: The goddess Death resists killing beings until Brahma assures her it is righteous; diseases arise from her tears and death becomes part of cosmic order.

image_candidates.scene_text: The maiden Death stands on one foot in severe penance for ages beneath the gaze of Brahma.
Death, with tears cupped in her joined hands before Brahma, weeps as the drops become terrible diseases.
Brahma commands the reluctant goddess Death while she stands silent with uplifted eyes before the creator of the worlds.
